items: Added SenseNova Token Plan.
Added PEKPIK LLM.
Added Aevon.
Added Api.Airforce.
Added Tencent EdgeOne Makers Models (500K free tokens/month on 9 built-in models).
Added Typhoon API (free tier, 200 req/min).
NaraRouter Free plan cut from 3 models to 1 (laguna-s-2.1); still 7M tokens/day, 15 RPM.
BazaarLink free models down from 7 to 6.
Added River AI.
Added Experiential Labs.
Added Runcrate.
Added InferAll.
Added Flux Router.
Added Flexlora, IteraCompute, Inception.
NaraRouter free models cut from 5 to 3 (still 7M tokens/day, 15 RPM).
Rechecked Infron, Token Harbor and AMD Token Factory docs.
Added GW BUS, EURI by Euron, APIBridge, rout.my.
APInex free allowance cut from 10M to 3M tokens/day.
Added Aion Labs, Frenix, MixRoute, Bay of Assets / Routeriva.
Added Router9, Ramp Router, Bytez, ModelScope API-Inference.
Added OpenCode Zen, Electron Hub, Pollinations.
BazaarLink free list grew from 2 to 7 models.
Added Onomeo, LLM Gateway.
Added Vikasit AI, xKiro, BlazeAPI, CrowLLM.
Added AIHubMix, Routeway, Clean APIs, Agnes AI, AMD Radeon Cloud Token Factory, Vercel AI Gateway.
Hugging Face free monthly credits ended; SambaNova Free needs card + purchase; Fireworks signup credit removed.
Added OrcaRouter, Nous Portal.
NaraRouter free models cut from 10 to 5.
Added TrustedRouter, Batchrate, ParalonCloud.
Added FreeTheAI, Requesty, Kilo Gateway, OVHcloud AI Endpoints.
Added Gonka Broker, FreeAIapikey, Vireonix, Infron, Token Harbor.
APInex free rate dropped to 5 RPM per IP.
Added DreamPrompting, LLM7.io, AnyAPI, Y-API daily key.
Added BazaarLink, YepAPI, WanAPIs, TokenFaucet.
Added Free.ai, UnoRouter.
Added NaraRouter, NVIDIA Build.

Initial list: Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter, Cloudflare, SambaNova, Mistral, Z.ai, Cohere, Hugging Face, SiliconFlow, Ollama Cloud, Cerebras, Fireworks, Alibaba Model Studio, Google Cloud express mode, Anthropic, APInex.

sites.name: Gemini API (Google AI Studio)
sites.free_allowance: Free tier on selected Gemini models
sites.limits: Per-model RPM/RPD on Google's rate-limit page
sites.notes: Free-tier prompts may be used to improve Google products.

sites.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
sites.notes: Allowance is in Neurons; token equivalent depends on model.

sites.name: SambaNova Cloud
sites.notes: Since 15 Oct the Free plan requires a card and a purchase.

sites.name: Cohere
sites.notes: Trial keys are for non-production use.

sites.name: Hugging Face Inference Providers
sites.notes: Free monthly Inference credits ended (reported 15 Oct).

sites.name: NVIDIA Build / NIM
sites.notes: Models include Kimi K3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GLM 5.3.

sites.name: Google Cloud Vertex AI express mode
Anthropic API
sites.notes: OpenAI SDK compatibility layer; no free daily allowance published.

sites.name: APInex
sites.notes: Cut from 10M to 3M/day on 23 Oct. Free models: free/gpt-6-luna, free/deepseek-v4.1-flash, free/gemini-3.8-flash. Paid 10/20/30-day plans. Model names are its own catalogue labels.

sites.name: NaraRouter
sites.notes: Free plan now only laguna-s-2.1 (cut 10→5 on 14 Oct, 5→3 on 26 Oct, 3→1 on 28 Oct). Also Anthropic compatible.

sites.name: BazaarLink
sites.notes: Free list grew from 2 to 7 models on 20 Oct, now 6 (28 Oct). Limits shared across free models, resets 00:00 UTC.

sites.name: TokenFaucet
sites.free_allowance: Daily token lucky draw (amount not published)
sites.notes: Third-party relay; genuinely free models mainly MiMo and MiniMax. Also Anthropic compatible.

sites.name: Gonka Broker
sites.notes: Renews on the 1st of each month.

sites.name: Vireonix
sites.free_allowance: No key needed; hourly fair use

sites.name: Infron
sites.notes: Standard free models need a $5+ balance (not consumed).

sites.name: Token Harbor
sites.notes: Free-model prompts may be retained. Also Anthropic compatible.

sites.name: AMD Radeon Cloud Token Factory
sites.free_allowance: Free models with a daily points cap
sites.notes: China site only; dev/trial use, not production.

sites.name: xKiro
sites.free_allowance: 500K tokens/day (1M/day with Telegram verify), 40+ free models
sites.notes: Also a one-off 30M bonus for 30 days after Telegram verification.

sites.name: Onomeo
sites.notes: Beta; free answers carry a 'via onomeo.com' line.

sites.name: LLM Gateway
sites.free_allowance: Zero-priced free models, no credits needed

sites.name: Electron Hub
sites.free_allowance: 10 requests/day on :free models (up to 200 with ads) + $0.25 weekly credit

sites.name: Ramp Router
sites.notes: Responses API only, no Chat Completions.

sites.name: GW BUS
sites.free_allowance: $5 signup credit + 1M tokens/day on Free plan

sites.name: Experiential Labs
sites.free_allowance: 1M tokens/day shared on free core models (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GPT-6 Luna, Clef)
sites.notes: One-time $1 card check needed for free models (credited back as balance). Also Anthropic Messages and Responses API.

sites.name: Runcrate
sites.free_allowance: Free usage on 5 open models (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GLM 5.3, GLM 5.3 Flash, gpt-oss 120B, Qwen3.8 Flash)
sites.limits: Session cap plus weekly allowance (resets Monday); sizes unpublished
sites.notes: Needs a GitHub account at least 30 days old. Free requests served by third-party providers.

sites.name: InferAll
sites.free_allowance: 25 free calls, then 25 calls/day free on 10+ NVIDIA NIM open models
sites.limits: 25 calls/day (50 chat/day after one-time $5 starter pack)
sites.notes: Also Anthropic compatible at https://api.inferall.ai. Run by Kindly Robotics.

sites.name: Flux Router
sites.free_allowance: $1 of usage per month on the Free plan
sites.notes: Smart-routing gateway (flux-auto), 78+ models, also Anthropic compatible.

sites.name: River AI (River Inference)
sites.notes: Credit announced by CEO Igor Babuschkin on X on 11 Oct 2026 for sign-ups 'right now'; not on the pricing page, may have ended. Models include DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and GLM-5.3 Flash.

sites.name: Tencent EdgeOne Makers Models
sites.limits: 300 s max per request; rate limits on abuse
sites.notes: Built-in models: @makers/hy3, hy3-preview, deepseek-v4-pro, deepseek-v4-flash, deepseek-v4.1-flash, minimax-m3, minimax-m2.7, kimi-k2.6, zhuque-text. Not for production. Also BYOK for OpenAI/Anthropic/Google etc. with no platform fee. Anthropic compatible too.

sites.name: Typhoon API (OpenTyphoon)
sites.free_allowance: Free tier on Typhoon models (light usage)
sites.notes: Thai-first models: typhoon-v2.5-30b-a3b-instruct, typhoon-v2.1-12b-instruct; also OCR and ASR APIs. Key from Typhoon Playground.

sites.name: SenseNova Token Plan
sites.free_allowance: Free public-beta Token Plan: shared credit pool across Kimi K3, GLM-5.2, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and SenseNova models
sites.limits: Credits per rolling 5 hours and per week (reported 120K/5h and 1.2M/week since 27 Oct); credits, not tokens
sites.notes: Also Anthropic Messages compatible. Credit pool figures from third-party trackers; official page is JS-only.

sites.name: PEKPIK LLM
sites.free_allowance: $1 on email verify, then one daily claim (up to $20 over first 40 days, continues after)
sites.limits: 10 requests/min on free tier; daily claim resets balance, no stacking

sites.name: Aevon
sites.free_allowance: $100 free credits on signup via GitHub; 3 Free Tier models
sites.notes: Gateway on Venice AI infra, has its own crypto token; also Anthropic base URL. Treat as prototype-only.

sites.name: Api.Airforce
sites.free_allowance: Free plan $0/month on basic models (e.g. gpt-oss-20b)
sites.notes: Multi-model gateway, 100+ models on paid plans.
